question: List the most recently updated proposal-development proposals.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, p.IP_NUMBER, p.STATUS_CODE, p.UPDATE_TIMESTAMP FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p ORDER BY p.UPDATE_TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 20
explanation: EPS_PROPOSAL is the canonical proposal-development table.

question: Find proposal-development proposals with a supplied status code.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, p.STATUS_CODE FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p WHERE p.STATUS_CODE = '1' ORDER BY p.TITLE
explanation: Uses EPS_PROPOSAL.STATUS_CODE; labels live in EPS_PROPOSAL_STATUS.

question: List proposal-development proposals submitted between two dates.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, p.SUBMISSION_DATE FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p WHERE p.SUBMISSION_DATE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY p.SUBMISSION_DATE
explanation: SUBMISSION_DATE is on EPS_PROPOSAL.

question: How many proposal-development proposals are there for each status?
sql: SELECT ps.STATUS_CODE, ps.DESCRIPTION, COUNT(p.PROPOSAL_ID) AS proposal_count FROM EPS_PROPOSAL_STATUS ps LEFT JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL p ON p.STATUS_CODE = ps.STATUS_CODE GROUP BY ps.STATUS_CODE, ps.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY ps.DESCRIPTION
explanation: Join EPS_PROPOSAL to EPS_PROPOSAL_STATUS on STATUS_CODE.

question: Show proposals associated with a person named Will Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.TITLE FROM PROPOSAL p JOIN PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE LOWER(pp.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER
explanation: Ambiguous 'proposals' defaults to institutional PROPOSAL + PROPOSAL_PERSONS.FULL_NAME. Do not use ERA_PROPOSAL_PERSON_ROLES.

question: List proposal-development proposals and their PIs.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, pp.PERSON_ID, pp.FULL_NAME FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE pp.PI_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY p.TITLE
explanation: PI_FLAG on EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS marks the PI.

question: List all people and roles on a specified proposal-development proposal.
sql: SELECT pp.PROPOSAL_ID, pp.PERSON_ID, pp.ROLODEX_ID, pp.FULL_NAME, pp.PROP_PERSON_ROLE_ID, pp.PI_FLAG, pp.PROJECT_ROLE FROM EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp WHERE pp.PROPOSAL_ID = 70 ORDER BY pp.PI_FLAG DESC, pp.FULL_NAME
explanation: People for a development proposal live in EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS.

question: List institutional proposals with their proposal numbers and submission dates.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.SEQUENCE_NUMBER, p.TITLE, p.SUBMISSION_DATE FROM PROPOSAL p ORDER BY p.SUBMISSION_DATE DESC
explanation: PROPOSAL is the canonical institutional proposal table.

question: Find institutional proposals with a supplied status code.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.TITLE, p.STATUS_CODE FROM PROPOSAL p WHERE p.STATUS_CODE = '1' ORDER BY p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER
explanation: Institutional status is PROPOSAL.STATUS_CODE.

question: List institutional proposals submitted within a date range.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.TITLE, p.SUBMISSION_DATE FROM PROPOSAL p WHERE p.SUBMISSION_DATE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY p.SUBMISSION_DATE
explanation: SUBMISSION_DATE is on PROPOSAL.

question: List proposal-development proposals with their declared sponsors.
sql: SELECT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL_SPONSORS ps ON ps.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID JOIN SPONSOR s ON s.SPONSOR_CODE = ps.SPONSOR_CODE ORDER BY p.TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME
explanation: Declared sponsors are EPS_PROPOSAL_SPONSORS; names come from SPONSOR.

question: Count institutional proposals by sponsor.
sql: SELECT s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID) AS proposal_count FROM SPONSOR s JOIN PROPOSAL_SPONSORS ps ON ps.SPONSOR_CODE = s.SPONSOR_CODE JOIN PROPOSAL p ON p.PROPOSAL_ID = ps.PROPOSAL_ID GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY proposal_count DESC
explanation: PROPOSAL_SPONSORS links institutional proposals to the SPONSOR master.

question: List awards with a supplied status code.
sql: SELECT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.SEQUENCE_NUMBER, a.TITLE, a.STATUS_CODE FROM AWARD a WHERE a.STATUS_CODE = '1' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.SEQUENCE_NUMBER DESC
explanation: AWARD is the canonical award table.

question: List awards effective within a date range.
sql: SELECT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, a.AWARD_EFFECTIVE_DATE, a.FINAL_EXPIRATION_DATE FROM AWARD a WHERE a.AWARD_EFFECTIVE_DATE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' ORDER BY a.AWARD_EFFECTIVE_DATE
explanation: Effective and expiration dates are on AWARD.

question: Find awards associated with a person named Will Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, ap.PERSON_ID, ap.FULL_NAME FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_PERSONS ap ON ap.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID WHERE LOWER(ap.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: Canonical award people table is AWARD_PERSONS.

question: List awards and their PIs.
sql: SELECT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, ap.PERSON_ID, ap.FULL_NAME FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_PERSONS ap ON ap.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID WHERE ap.PI_FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: PI_FLAG on AWARD_PERSONS marks the PI.

question: Which awards are linked to a specified institutional proposal number?
sql: SELECT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_FUNDING_PROPOSALS afp ON afp.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID JOIN PROPOSAL p ON p.PROPOSAL_ID = afp.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER = '1' AND afp.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: AWARD_FUNDING_PROPOSALS links awards to institutional PROPOSAL.

question: Count current awards by sponsor.
sql: SELECT s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT a.AWARD_NUMBER) AS award_count FROM SPONSOR s JOIN AWARD a ON a.SPONSOR_CODE = s.SPONSOR_CODE WHERE a.IS_LATEST = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY award_count DESC
explanation: Use AWARD.SPONSOR_CODE to the SPONSOR master, not a feed table.

question: How many agreements are there?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS agreement_count FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER
explanation: AGREEMENT_HEADER is the canonical agreement table.

question: List the most recent agreement headers.
sql: SELECT ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ah.AGREEMENT_STATUS_CODE, ah.CREATE_TIMESTAMP FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER ah ORDER BY ah.CREATE_TIMESTAMP DESC LIMIT 20
explanation: Agreement headers live in AGREEMENT_HEADER.

question: Find agreements with a supplied status code.
sql: SELECT ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ah.AGREEMENT_STATUS_CODE, ast.DESCRIPTION FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER ah JOIN AGREEMENT_STATUS ast ON ast.AGREEMENT_STATUS_CODE = ah.AGREEMENT_STATUS_CODE WHERE ah.AGREEMENT_STATUS_CODE = '1' ORDER BY ah.TITLE
explanation: Join AGREEMENT_HEADER to AGREEMENT_STATUS.

question: List agreements whose start dates fall within a range, with their people and sponsors.
sql: SELECT ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ah.START_DATE, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ap.FULL_NAME ORDER BY ap.FULL_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS people, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME SEPARATOR ', ') AS sponsors FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER ah LEFT JOIN AGREEMENT_PEOPLE ap ON ap.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID = ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN AGREEMENT_SPONSOR ags ON ags.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID = ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID LEFT JOIN SPONSOR s ON s.SPONSOR_CODE = ags.SPONSOR_CODE WHERE ah.START_DATE BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' GROUP BY ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ah.START_DATE ORDER BY ah.START_DATE
explanation: People via AGREEMENT_PEOPLE; sponsors via AGREEMENT_SPONSOR to SPONSOR.

question: List active sponsors.
sql: SELECT s.SPONSOR_CODE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, s.ACRONYM FROM SPONSOR s WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' ORDER BY s.SPONSOR_NAME
explanation: SPONSOR is the master; do not query link tables for the sponsor list.

question: What is the predicted probability that each proposal-development proposal will be funded?
explanation: No proposal-funding prediction field exists in the mapped schema.

question: What is each investigator's Scopus h-index?
explanation: Person records have identity and role data, not Scopus metrics.

question: What is the current NIH payline for the next application cycle?
explanation: No NIH payline table exists in the mapped modules.

question: Find proposal-development proposals associated with Will Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, p.IP_NUMBER FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE LOWER(pp.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY p.TITLE
explanation: Development proposals use EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS.FULL_NAME, not ERA_PROPOSAL_PERSON_ROLES.

question: Find institutional proposals associated with Will Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.TITLE FROM PROPOSAL p JOIN PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE LOWER(pp.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER
explanation: Institutional proposals use PROPOSAL_PERSONS.FULL_NAME.

question: Show proposal-development proposals where Will Smith is the PI.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, pp.FULL_NAME FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE pp.PI_FLAG = 'Y' AND LOWER(pp.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY p.TITLE
explanation: Filter EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS by PI_FLAG and FULL_NAME.

question: Find proposal-development proposals where Will Smith is a co-investigator.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.TITLE, pp.FULL_NAME, r.DESCRIPTION AS person_role FROM EPS_PROPOSAL p JOIN EPS_PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID JOIN EPS_PROP_PERSON_ROLE r ON r.PROP_PERSON_ROLE_ID = pp.PROP_PERSON_ROLE_ID WHERE r.DESCRIPTION LIKE '%Co-Investigator%' AND LOWER(pp.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY p.TITLE
explanation: Join EPS_PROP_PERSON_ROLE for the role label; do not use the ERA feed.

question: Find awards whose PI is Will Smith.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, ap.FULL_NAME FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_PERSONS ap ON ap.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID WHERE ap.PI_FLAG = 'Y' AND LOWER(ap.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: Award PIs are AWARD_PERSONS with PI_FLAG = 'Y'.

question: Find awards associated with the employee whose email is will.smith@example.edu.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, ap.FULL_NAME, person.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_PERSONS ap ON ap.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID JOIN PERSON person ON person.PERSON_ID = ap.PERSON_ID WHERE LOWER(person.EMAIL_ADDRESS) = LOWER('will.smith@example.edu') ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: Email lives on PERSON, joined via AWARD_PERSONS.PERSON_ID.

question: List awards associated with person ID 12345.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT a.AWARD_ID, a.AWARD_NUMBER, a.TITLE, ap.PERSON_ID, ap.FULL_NAME FROM AWARD a JOIN AWARD_PERSONS ap ON ap.AWARD_ID = a.AWARD_ID WHERE ap.PERSON_ID = '12345' ORDER BY a.AWARD_NUMBER
explanation: Filter AWARD_PERSONS.PERSON_ID.

question: Find agreements that list Will Smith as a person.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ap.FULL_NAME FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER ah JOIN AGREEMENT_PEOPLE ap ON ap.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID = ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID WHERE LOWER(ap.FULL_NAME) LIKE '%will smith%' ORDER BY ah.TITLE
explanation: Agreement people live in AGREEMENT_PEOPLE.

question: Find agreements listing an employee with email will.smith@example.edu.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID, ah.TITLE, ap.FULL_NAME, person.EMAIL_ADDRESS FROM AGREEMENT_HEADER ah JOIN AGREEMENT_PEOPLE ap ON ap.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID = ah.AGREEMENT_REQUEST_ID JOIN PERSON person ON person.PERSON_ID = ap.PERSON_ID WHERE LOWER(person.EMAIL_ADDRESS) = LOWER('will.smith@example.edu') ORDER BY ah.TITLE
explanation: Join AGREEMENT_PEOPLE to PERSON for email.

question: List institutional proposals associated with person ID 12345.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT p.PROPOSAL_ID, p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER, p.TITLE, pp.PERSON_ID, pp.FULL_NAME FROM PROPOSAL p JOIN PROPOSAL_PERSONS pp ON pp.PROPOSAL_ID = p.PROPOSAL_ID WHERE pp.PERSON_ID = '12345' ORDER BY p.PROPOSAL_NUMBER
explanation: Institutional people filter is PROPOSAL_PERSONS.PERSON_ID.
